name: Segway
what_failed: Personal transportation device that never achieved mass adoption despite massive hype and $100M+ investment.
why_it_failed: No infrastructure (sidewalks too narrow, roads too dangerous)
Solved a problem most people didn't have
assumptions_that_broke: People want to stand while commuting
Urban infrastructure would adapt to personal vehicles
constraints_that_moved: Battery cost decreased (but too late for Segway)
lesson: A technically brilliant solution to a problem most people don't have will fail against a mediocre solution to a problem everyone has.
